purpose: Human-behavior-first entry points into executable external-effect correctness.

probes.title: It starts raining after approval
probes.observed_phenomenon: A previously valid physical authorization becomes unsafe before dispatch because the world changes.
probes.probe_primitive: change reality after approval and ask whether the action still executes
probes.digital_translation: one-click browser scenario with pre-dispatch state change
probes.invariant: authorization valid at check time != authorization valid at dispatch time

build_double_kill.build: visitor can trigger and understand the blocked stale authorization
build_double_kill.double: independent runtime reproduces/adapts the vector or external reviewer requests a native fixture
build_double_kill.kill: users cannot explain the failure boundary after interaction or the vector cannot reproduce the runtime decision

probes.title: The ACK disappears
probes.observed_phenomenon: Transport uncertainty is easily mistaken for physical-effect failure, causing unsafe replay.
probes.probe_primitive: remove the ACK and force the user/system to decide whether to retry or inspect reality
probes.digital_translation: one-click lost-ACK story that keeps effect outcome unresolved until readback
probes.maturity: runtime primitives + portable vectors + browser-playable; field campaign incomplete

build_double_kill.build: visitor sees why blind retry is unsafe
build_double_kill.double: another project imports/adapts the vector or cites the distinction
build_double_kill.kill: probe encourages retry behavior without readback or cannot distinguish attempt identity from effect identity

probes.title: The sensor says 40% — but it is stale
probes.observed_phenomenon: A numerically correct observation is treated as proof even though it predates the action.
probes.probe_primitive: show a plausible value then reveal that its timestamp invalidates the claim
probes.digital_translation: one-click browser scenario that changes CONFIRMED-looking evidence into UNRESOLVED
probes.maturity: runtime-enforced + portable vector + browser-playable; field campaign incomplete

build_double_kill.double: third party reproduces the UNRESOLVED result from the vector
build_double_kill.kill: UI implies numerical agreement alone confirms the physical effect
